bio: The back and forth of the ferry bringing guests to this magnificent establishment makes for a wonderful spectacle in the evenings. Inside, the decor has been given a makeover and creates a modern yet intimate atmosphere, with the surrounding water playing an integral part in the overall look. The intriguing flavour combinations in the modern, occasionally oriental dishes provide the basis for an exciting culinary experience. Think an exotic/fresh/zesty combination of mango, passion fruit, coconut and fried rice noodles. Dinner at Tante Kee is quite an adventure!...
